items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Clyde Hart worked with us, because Benny Goodman took, you know, as I said, Benny stole Jimmy Rowles, but Clyde Hart used to work with us when we were at the Cafe Society.

ctx.x: Jerry Colon was a trombone player. Well, at the Famous Door, when I went to the Famous Door, well, Jerry Colon's brother owned the Famous Door and he was a red headed fellow; his name was Red something, they called him - I don't remember what his name was. But he brought Stuff Smith out, okay. Stuff Smith played the Famous Door -- the Famous Door was right there by the Union. Now this is 1937. The reason I know this is 1937 is because we followed him in there with Fats Waller. Fats Waller I followed ... I worked…
Who all can you remember being there at the jam sessions?
